'''2013 Worlds Day 2 RSmith DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[RSmith]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Buck Faston
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
